command: set -eu; PR_JSON=$(gh pr view 28 --repo kelvinhuang0327/Healthy --json state,mergedAt,mergeCommit,headRefName,headRefOid,baseRefName,url); MERGE_SHA=$(printf "%s" "$PR_JSON" | jq -r .mergeCommit.oid); test "$MERGE_SHA" = 863d56b4428aaf3ffad6d24635f3edaec5d4269f; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$MERGE_SHA"; git merge-base --is-ancestor 07e65957263b7754f29f095e3ef79a6e006b8d7f origin/main; CHECKS=$(gh api "repos/kelvinhuang0327/Healthy/commits/$MERGE_SHA/check-runs"); test "$(printf "%s" "$CHECKS" | jq -r ".check_runs[] | select(.name == \"verify\") | .conclusion")" = success; REMOTE_FEATURE=$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/codex/healthy-sqlite-persistence-v1 | cut -f1); test "$REMOTE_FEATURE" = 07e65957263b7754f29f095e3ef79a6e006b8d7f; printf "%s\n" "PR_STATE=MERGED" "MERGE_SHA=$MERGE_SHA" "ORIGIN_MAIN=$MERGE_SHA" "FEATURE_REMOTE=$REMOTE_FEATURE" "POST_MERGE_VERIFY=PASS"
